coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variables (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, prefill execution time, decoding execution time, peak memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors. Decoding time is represented through latency and total-time-based throughput measurements.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies model size instead of holding LLaMA-2-7B fixed and does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its methodology. It sweeps batch sizes and prompt lengths instead of using only batch size 1 and prefill length 2048, and specifies 256 generation tokens rather than 32 decode steps. Combined prefill-plus-decode execution time is missing. Additional baselines and speculative performance claims expand beyond the specified experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output field is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected comparison of FP16 and 4-bit LLaMa-2 performance metrics.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied in the designated field; the required prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup comparison is absent.
